geometry.high_velocity_basis: two real orthonormal divergence-free polarizations divided by |k|, so each complex coordinate is gradient-normalized

growth_summary.interpretation: Finite-window spectra diagnose the next proof route. They do not prove asymptotic divergence or a window-uniform bound.
growth_summary.observed_route_signal: Axial length is nearly saturated over 4 to 8 modes, while transverse widening and three-dimensional slab length produce strongly increasing direct witnesses dominated by the high-high pressure term.

next_theorem_target: Extract a separable divergence-free high-carrier family from the pressure-dominated slab witnesses. Compute its weighted Fisher energy and high-high pressure HHL load analytically as the longitudinal and transverse Dirichlet windows grow. Either prove an explicit divergent lower ratio, which closes the joint-Schur route as a no-go, or identify the cancellation missing from the finite numerical witness.
scope: This is a finite-window joint incidence calculation, not an analytic uniform theorem. It removes the repeated-Fisher bookkeeping error inside the tested windows and exposes the normalized graph whose growth must next be bounded or converted into a rigorous obstruction.
